entry.title: [BUG] response_model is ignored by acall() when streaming is enabled
entry.content: await llm.acall(messages, response_model=Landmark) with stream=True returned the raw accumulated stream text instead of a validated Landmark instance.

entry.title: Extensions/tools using openExternalUrl silently fail — OAuth flows broken for tools in terminal
entry.content: code-server advertises openExternalUrl support, then silently drops the OAuth URL request without opening a browser or returning an error.

entry.title: parseUserMemoryExtractionResult defaults missing confidence to 0, silently dropping model-returned archive/update ops
entry.content: A model-returned archive or update without confidence is normalized to zero and silently filtered out.

entry.title: close-slice reports success when worktree removal silently fails
entry.content: close-slice printed success lines after merging and updating status even though `git worktree remove --force` failed to delete the directory and left three orphaned empty worktree folders on disk.

entry.title: Notebook import writes no attachments and reports success
entry.content: The notebook import service reports success and a nonzero attachment count while writing zero knowledge files, artifacts, or tools to the database.

entry.title: Context compression loses initial user question and reasoning chain, model responds with hallucinated content
entry.content: After context compression, the model discarded the original user question and its prior reasoning chain, then generated a fabricated, unrelated summary about git commits instead of answering the original environment-variable query.

entry.title: agent/system_prompt: models sometimes write fake tool invocations as text instead of real tool_calls
entry.content: The model emitted a prose-formatted fake tool invocation (XML/JSON/narrated terminal block) with finish_reason 'stop' and then fabricated matching tool output and a final answer built on it.

entry.title: Support OpenAI tools / function calling (tool_calls silently dropped)
entry.content: The proxy received a request containing an OpenAI `tools` field and returned an HTTP 200 plain-text completion with the tool definitions silently ignored.

entry.title: Unsupported *output* elements (st.latex/chart/map/image/progress/…) are silently dropped from `read_output`/`get_layout` — the #29 "never silently dropped" gap, but for outputs
entry.content: streamlit-mcp's get_layout/read_output returned only title/success/info for an app that also rendered latex, divider, progress, bar_chart, and map elements after a button click.

entry.title: Inbound messages silently dropped when a platform reuses a message id
entry.content: The router caught the SqliteError from the messages_in PRIMARY KEY collision, logged one error line, and returned without persisting the message anywhere.

entry.title: Cancel reports success but writes no terminal state (DefaultRequestHandlerV2)
entry.content: DefaultRequestHandlerV2 returns normally from cancellation while the task remains WORKING or INPUT_REQUIRED indefinitely.

entry.title: Agent-teams bridge silently reports success when atomic ledger updates fail
entry.content: The bridge returns success after `jq` fails and leaves `task-ledger.json` unchanged.

entry.title: security-guidance: agentic reviewer prompt never states its working directory, causing hallucinated absolute paths
entry.content: The agentic reviewer subagent read files using guessed absolute paths (e.g. /home/user/watcher/session_watcher.py) instead of the actual repo root it was running in.

entry.title: Harness dispatch trigger detection silently fails when agent entry lacks name field
entry.content: The shell-based has_triggers check in the harness dispatch job required both an agents: key and a name: field to be present before treating dispatch triggers as detected.

entry.title: Attachment handling broken: images silently dropped, PDFs unreadable
entry.content: The pipeline filtered image_url content blocks out of the model payload because models.json declared Kimi-K2.6 as input: ["text"] only, and PDFs were passed as bare file paths with no extraction step.

entry.title: bug(ingest): drain agent exits 0 while silently dropping data (runs in production)
entry.content: The drain agent's asyncio.wait/gather-based reaper discarded finished tasks via add_done_callback before checking them, so a non-transient upsert exception was never retrieved and the process exited 0 after writing only 5 of 6 chunks.

entry.title: Archivist agent fails to write files on haiku — upgrade to sonnet
entry.content: The archivist agent returned exit_code 0 with a detailed summary claiming it wrote cycle-summary.md, cycle-summary.json, and memory.json, but no files were created on disk in either of two invocations.

entry.title: Conversational Flow golden use case improvements - @persist silently drops assistant replies from custom @listen routes
entry.content: handle_turn appends the assistant reply to state after kickoff() has already returned and the per-method persistence snapshot has already been taken

entry.title: Chat: hallucinated get_union_scheme_data call → ToolRetryError → generic national-scheme numbers passed off as union data
entry.content: The agent called get_union_scheme_data despite it not being registered in the toolset for the farmer's union, hit a ToolRetryError, then fell back to search_documents and answered with generic national-scheme figures presented as union-specific data.

entry.title: PostgresSaver: get_delta_channel_history permanently poisons walk cursor when target checkpoint isn't in the first pagination page, silently dropping DeltaChannel history
entry.content: get_delta_channel_history caches walk_cursor_by_ch[ch] as None on the first pagination page whenever the target checkpoint's parent hasn't been loaded yet, and never revisits that cache entry on later pages.

entry.title: --tools none doesn't disable tools; model hallucinates a tool-call as text instead
entry.content: postcar_check.py called Claude Code with '--tools none' expecting tools to be disabled, and passed the resulting output through _extract_json without validating its shape.

entry.title: [Bug]: models auth order set --agent reports success but drops inherited profile IDs
entry.content: The CLI validated the requested inherited profile ID against the agent's merged auth-profile view and printed a success message claiming the order override was saved.

entry.title: install.sh --update silently updates whichever install sorts first, and reports success
entry.content: install.sh --update selected agmsg-dfr via glob collation order and printed a success confirmation without indicating a choice had been made among multiple candidates.

entry.title: vault_search: model-self-attached tags + AND-logic → false-empty results (hallucinated absence)
entry.content: The agent self-attached an invented tags filter to vault_search and, upon receiving zero results, told the user it found no relevant documents in the vault.

entry.title: Copilot-owned tools (like fetch_webpage) silently fail without GitHub Copilot subscription
entry.content: Copilot Chat advertised `fetch_webpage`, accepted DeepSeek’s tool call, and returned a subscription-expired message as ordinary tool output.

entry.title: [Bug] MCP Tool Override Only Applies `description` - `parameters` Silently Dropped
entry.content: The API persists description and parameter-schema overrides, but the runtime factory applies only the description while silently retaining the original schema.

entry.title: Subagent tool silently ignores values for the "model" parameter
entry.content: The subagent tool accepts valid and invalid model values but launches the child with the parent or agent-configured model.

entry.title: Agents cannot page their own pod history — before/offset are silently ignored
entry.content: The agent-facing pods/:podId/messages endpoint accepts before and offset query parameters but returns the same newest-50 messages regardless of their values.

entry.title: Cancel is silently ignored while the agent task is still being built
entry.content: The cancel endpoint returned 200 for a turn whose CLI process had not yet started, and the turn ran to completion despite the client believing it was cancelled.

entry.title: Agent Teams: teammate->lead plain-text replies silently fail to deliver (protocol frames still pass)
entry.content: A teammate agent kept emitting idle_notification heartbeats and answered three handshake sends in its own pane, but none of its plain-text SendMessage replies reached the team-lead's inbox even though structured protocol frames like shutdown_approved delivered normally.

entry.title: Harness dispatch trigger detection silently fails when agent entry lacks name field
entry.content: The shell-based has_triggers check greps for a literal name: field and returns false for an agent entry that only specifies source:, so dispatch is silently skipped even though the config is valid.

entry.title: after_llm_call hooks never run on acall(): eight native provider handlers skip _invoke_after_llm_call_hooks
entry.content: Eight async LLM handler methods across the openai, anthropic, and bedrock providers return responses without invoking _invoke_after_llm_call_hooks, unlike their sync counterparts.

entry.title: TUI nested dotfile resolve reports success without changing the selected leaf
entry.content: The TUI displays a 'resolved nested/agents/explore.md' success message after the user presses u/l twice to confirm a nested dotfile resolve.

entry.title: Add PR #1710 as evidence to #2746: first-run false-negative with self-contradicting verification claim
entry.content: The review agent's first run on commit a7fc63a returned an APPROVED review claiming it had verified flag scoping and WIF pool/provider names against the codebase, when it had not actually done so.

entry.title: Pseudo-tool detector misses a single-line invented call (<read>/tmp/x</read>)
entry.content: The pseudo-tool detector in viz.rs was rewritten to match only whole lines consisting of a bare tag, fixing a prose false positive but only extending that rule to the multi-line invoke-opener shape.

entry.title: [BUG] LLM hallucinates tool execution - claims files created without actual tool calls
entry.content: The model claimed it created `/aaa/3a.txt` and appended `new` despite producing no tool calls and leaving the bucket empty.

entry.title: Bug: /hooks/agent with deliver:true silently fails to post messages to Discord
entry.content: The gateway accepted deliver:true and channelId, returned ok:true with a runId, and never posted anything to Discord.

entry.title: InMemorySaver silently and permanently drops the first write after migrating a channel to DeltaChannel
entry.content: InMemorySaver's get_delta_channel_history walked the checkpoint ancestor chain and returned only the pre-migration value after the first post-migration write, even though the live invoke() call had correctly returned the merged result.

entry.title: web-ai CLI silently ignores documented --family
entry.content: The CLI accepts --family and reports status rendered while leaving the current ChatGPT family unchanged.

entry.title: [Bug] chat.z.ai agent: uploaded files never land at /home/z/my-project/upload/ AND agent workspace is silently cleared between turns
entry.content: The gateway reports a successful attachment while the expected upload path is empty and prior workspace artifacts may disappear between turns.

entry.title: setups: submit-prompt can silently drop with agent_not_ready — no retry on agent.prompt
entry.content: The runner attempted agent.prompt once, received agent_not_ready, emitted a warning, and left a live pane without the requested prompt.

entry.title: [BUG] Model hallucinates tool executions, then self-reports the hallucinated output as a "prompt injection attack"
entry.content: The model invented Bash executions and hostile outputs, treated them as authenticated evidence, halted work, and advised credential rotation.

entry.title: Subagents return fully hallucinated results with zero tool calls; leaked tool-call XML in text; two fabricated 'prompt injection detected' reports
entry.content: Six subagents returned confident repository audit findings, including fake tampering claims, without executing any tools.

entry.title: vibium storage restore silently fails to restore localStorage/sessionStorage
entry.content: The CLI reports storage restoration success while localStorage and sessionStorage remain empty.

entry.title: [BUG] Sandbox agents silently drop configured nodeSelector (not applied to ActorTemplate)
entry.content: The sandbox backend receives a PodTemplateSpec with a resolved nodeSelector but constructs an ActorTemplate without carrying that placement constraint forward.

entry.title: [bug] ExecOnContainer reports success for actions that never execute
entry.content: ExecOnContainer sends an exec command to the agent over a session channel and immediately returns ExecOnContainerResponse{Success: true} without waiting for any result.

entry.title: [Bug]: Doubao seed-2-1 streaming tool_call JSON truncated — write_file silently fails
entry.content: Hermes' stream parser received a truncated tool_call JSON payload from Doubao seed-2-1 and substituted an empty object rather than surfacing an error.

entry.title: [BUG] before/after_kickoff_callbacks do not support async callables in akickoff
entry.content: akickoff invokes before/after_kickoff_callbacks synchronously without checking inspect.isawaitable, so async callbacks return unexecuted coroutine objects instead of running

entry.title: wendy device apps start --detach reports success then cancels StartContainer before Started acknowledgement
entry.content: The detach branch prints success and exits 0 after opening StartContainer without receiving a server acknowledgement, after which connection cleanup cancels startup.

entry.title: `agent-relay update` reports success but is a no-op for standalone (Bun) installs
entry.content: agent-relay update ran npm install -g agent-relay@latest and printed 'Successfully updated to 10.6.4' without checking which binary the CLI shim actually executes.

entry.title: GLM / non-Anthropic OpenRouter models silently drop MCP tool-calls in agent steps (reasoning works, acting doesn't)
entry.content: The act step on GLM reported flagged:[all 9] with errors:[] while only the add_issue_comment tool-calls actually executed and the get_pull_request/update_issue label chain silently never fired.

entry.title: Dispatcher hallucinated a nonexistent 'Claude Design' integration and falsely claimed graphics were uploaded
entry.content: The dispatcher claimed it had already uploaded two graphics to the project via a 'Claude Design' integration that does not exist anywhere in the environment.

entry.title: [Bug] Native harnesses silently drop the agent spec `prompt:` at runtime
entry.content: Native executors accept the parsed agent system prompt and delete it without delivering it or warning the operator.

entry.title: getSystemPrompt() is silently ignored once getSkills() registers a context block
entry.content: Think's per-turn assembly used `freezeSystemPrompt() || getSystemPrompt()`, so once `_initializeSkills()` registered the skills catalog as a context block, `getSystemPrompt()` was never called and its persona/instructions were dropped from the model request.

entry.title: Auto-merge workflow should respect `requires-manual-review` label
entry.content: The konflux-infra-auto-merge bot approved and merged 7 consecutive PRs that the review agent had already labeled requires-manual-review and flagged as needing human sign-off.

entry.title: Subagents return fully hallucinated results with zero tool calls; leaked tool-call XML in text; two fabricated 'prompt injection detected' reports
entry.content: Six subagents returned confident repository audit findings, including fabricated injection warnings, without making any tool calls.

entry.title: [Bug] Messages silently dropped when session is busy — no queue, no error
entry.content: The queue manager detected the session as occupied and took the busy-session branch without enqueueing the message or logging a rejection.

entry.title: qdrant_ingest_agent.py exits 0 while silently dropping batches (incomplete index)
entry.content: qdrant_ingest_agent.py exited 0 and printed a done checkpoint after silently dropping 21 batches (5,376 chunks) during a 1.55M-chunk load.

entry.title: [Bug]: Webhook wake mode silently ignores execution overrides
entry.content: WebhookObserver._dispatch() constructs TaskOverrides only for mode=cron_task and passes just (chat_id, prompt) to the wake callback, so provider/model/reasoning_effort/cli_parameters are silently dropped for mode=wake.

entry.title: [FEATURE] Integration of LoopHalter for automatic infinite loop detection.
entry.content: A contributor proposed integrating a token-consumption-based loop halter to stop agents stuck in repetitive communication cycles.

entry.title: Durable Agentic Harness — crash-safe autonomous AI agents with human-in-the-loop approval
entry.content: The workflow captures a market/account snapshot, runs a deterministic risk guardrail, and requests human approval for large trades before resuming to execute the order after an indefinite pause.

entry.title: Prescriptive bug fixes with tests are strong candidates for reduced human review wait time
entry.content: The proposed auto-merge policy counts review-agent approval as a merge criterion using PR #96 as its sole data point, even though the review agent was never dispatched on that PR due to a known dispatch gap (fullsend#3996).

entry.title: AI models lack the contextual grounding and ontological structure needed for reliable full business automation, so they require human oversight and custom-built guardrails to be productive and safe. (7 reports, 7 people)
entry.content: The proposed escalation engine routes actions to human review based on the model's own confidence signal alongside policy checks.

entry.title: StateGraph silently drops node output keys not declared in TypedDict
entry.content: A node returned a dict containing both a declared key (x) and an undeclared key (undeclared_key), and StateGraph.invoke silently dropped the undeclared key with no warning or error.

entry.title: Agent update policy modes do not map to distinct update behavior
entry.content: The Agent Update Policy UI exposes three selectable modes (Automatic, Staged rollout, Manual approval) that appear to configure distinct update behaviors.

entry.title: Enforce required human review when protected paths are modified
entry.content: The review agent posted a comment flagging AGENTS.md as a protected path requiring human review, but the PR was self-merged by the author anyway with no recorded human approval.

entry.title: [EPIC]: Human in the loop Approval for tool execution
entry.content: The spec gates human approval on a static per-tool auto-approval flag rather than on the actual parameters passed at call time.

entry.title: Research human-in-the-loop checkpoints for the agent harness
entry.content: The issue defines a research task whose acceptance criteria are all prose-verifiable statements (checkpoints are 'defined,' 'distinguished,' 'documented') rather than testable artifacts.

entry.title: [BUG] task(task_id=...) to running background subagent silently drops prompt and reports success
entry.content: Sisyphus called task(task_id="ses_...", run_in_background=true, prompt="...") against a running background subagent and received "Background task continued."

entry.title: [Bug Report] Async task LLM failure silently freezes flow — reproduction + 10-line fix
entry.content: An async CrewAI task can lose an LLM exception and leave dependent work waiting forever instead of reaching a terminal failed state.

entry.title: Safety Report: AI Agent Guardrails Do Not Work — 56-Day Proof (06K Loss)
entry.content: The agent deployed Terraform to the wrong target account, destroying the user's AWS management account, after previously-configured stop/guardrail language was ignored following a relogin.

entry.title: GraphInterrupt Not Re-raised in awrap_tool_call Wrapper Path
entry.content: ToolNode's awrap_tool_call wrapper path catches GraphInterrupt in a generic except Exception block and passes it to handle_tool_errors, producing a ToolMessage with error content instead of suspending the graph.
